text:
lena_sales: Quick sync  Prospect (GreenGrid) wants an on-prem air-gapped POC. They want USB delivery, HSM-anchored offline license activation, strict no-call-home, and a monthly patch cadence if possible. Can we do this and what are the main constraints + price delta?

omar_se: We can, but need to confirm whether they expect signed incremental deltas or prefer full-image flashes for every update. Deltas save time but have compatibility constraints.

lena_sales: They wrote: 'prefer deltas monthly; reserve right for full-image hotfixes'. Also asked for an auditable attestation per release.

vivian_eng: Tech notes: we support minibundle deltas for runtime and control-plane layers. Two hard constraints:
- If model quantization/profile or KV cache layout changes -> deltas incompatible -> full-image required.
- Deltas require deterministic build inputs and strict version pinning.
We can detect incompatible changes at build time and mark a release as 'full-image-only'. Building a zero-telemetry artifact is supported via `--no-telemetry` but adds ~3 business days QA.

quentin_sec: Security side: we never hold customer private keys. Recommended flow: Redwood produces signed artifact + customer imports and re-signs inside their HSM. We can also provide a signed attestation PDF listing build hash, SBOM digest, and CI metadata. If customer requires Redwood to perform final signing inside their HSM, expect legal addendum + ops presence.

sam_ops: USB packaging ops:
- Bundle layout: `/manifest.txt`, `/sbom.json`, `/payload.tar.gz`, `/signature.sig`, `/verify.sh`
- We'll include `verify.sh` which checks sha256 sums and validates `signature.sig` against `redwood-verify.pub`.
- USB prep and manual QA add ~4 business days. For >3 updates, recommend a local repo mirror instead of repeated USBs.

artifact-bot: pipeline: `usb-bundle-build` queued for `poc/GreenGrid` (job id ag-617283). ETA 2024-10-22T14:00Z.

omar_se: Pricing back-of-envelope:
- One-time packaging & USB prep: $16,000
- SBOM + signed attestation pack: $3,000
- Monthly signed-delta retainer: $2,800/month
- Emergency full-image hotfix (per event): $5,500
- If we must integrate with customer HSM for final signing: one-time integration/legal ops fee ~$12,000 + longer lead time
(Will formalize in SOW).

lena_sales: Can we get a short preflight checklist I can send to GreenGrid? Need HSM cert format, courier chain-of-custody expectations, allowed maintenance windows, and acceptance tests.

vivian_eng: Copyable checklist:
- Provide HSM public cert fingerprint (PEM) and vendor/model + FIPS level.
- Confirm `--no-telemetry` opt-out if required.
- Delivery method: courier USB (provide ship-to contact & chain-of-custody policy) or local repo mirror credentials.
- Update cadence: monthly deltas; specify emergency hotfix SLA windows.
- Acceptance tests: signature verification, cold-start model load, basic inference smoke tests, p99 latency under agreed load.
- Rollback plan: keep previous full-image snapshot locally; deltas may be one-way if model formats change.
- Provide contact for emergency hotfixes and legal point-of-contact if HSM integration requested.

quentin_sec: Also add: we will provide signed attestations per release; for auditors we can include build logs snapshot and SBOM digests.

sam_ops: Note: if they request USB encryption with customer-supplied passphrase, we can accommodate but need the passphrase exchange method documented and it adds 1 business day.

omar_se: I'll add a caveat in the SOW about quantized-model-triggered full-image replacements and version pinning requirements.

lena_sales: Great  I'll send checklist + this pricing sketch to GreenGrid and request HSM fingerprint + maintenance windows. If they push for us to sign inside their HSM, I'll loop legal. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
